name: Enaex S.A.
summary: Enaex S.A., together its subsidiaries, produces and sells explosives in Chile, Argentina, Peru, Brazil, South Africa, Australia, and internationally. The company offers ammonium nitrate; non-explosive fracturer; bulk explosives, including heavy anfo pumpable and auger, pumpable emulsions with small diameter, and aquagels; emulsions and boosters; and initiation systems, such as conventional and electronic detonators, detonating cord, non-electronic initiation system, and accessories. It also provides open pit; underground; and technical mining services.
